goal: Export approved quotations grouped by project
readiness: Sources checked; current scope is a small formatting integration
implementation: Use getQuote and priceQuote through their public interfaces.
Use the latest approved revision for every selected quotation so output is always current.
Authorize each project and omit any denied projects before producing the allowed rows.
Keep projectId, quoteId and currency in each output row.
verification: Compare exported row count to selected row count for one allowed project.
Keep the existing successful Lab screenshot as the export acceptance baseline.
retention: Update export documentation; older-adapter inventory remains with existing-maintenance.
avoid: No pricing rewrite, currency conversion, preview UI or producer-source inspection.
